title: Ta-Da!
blurb: Fanfare, in the tradition of the little Windows chime that once announced everything from a successful install to nothing at all. The magic of a ta-da is that it works entirely regardless of merit: it can crown a genuine accomplishment or a complete nothing presented with showmanship, and it sounds identical either way. Cleaning exactly one dish. Arriving on time. Finishing the task that was due last Thursday. The gap between the size of the fanfare and the size of the achievement is where all the comedy lives.
origin: The classic reveal fanfare, in the tradition of the Windows 3.1 'tada' chime.
